definicion:
The indicator measures the share of obese people based on their body mass index (BMI). 
BMI is defined as the weight in kilos divided by the square of the height in meters. 
People aged 18 years or over are considered obese with a BMI equal or greater than 30.
formula:
$$PPO_{>18}^{t} = \frac{PO_{>18}^{t}}{P_{>18}^{t}} \cdot 100$$

where:

$PPO_{>18}^{t} =$ adult population with obesity (BMI>=30) in the year $t$

$P_{>18}^{t} =$ adult population in the year $t$
justificacion_global:
Although the EU has largely overcome hunger problems, new nutrition-related 
challenges are emerging, such as rising obesity.

Therefore, the European indicator measures obesity in adulthood and is used 
to monitor progress towards SDG 2 (ending hunger and malnutrition) and SDG 3 
(good health and well-being), which are included in the European Commission's 
priorities within the framework of the "European Green Deal," "An economy that 
works for people," and "Promoting our European way of life."

The EU's food policy includes nutrition initiatives and works with EU Member 
States on various public health initiatives in the areas of nutrition and physical 
activity to promote a healthy and balanced lifestyle.

Source: Eurostat

comparabilidad: The obesity rate among the adult population is comparable to the European indicator.

Adierazleak pertsona gizenen proportzioa neurtzen du, gorputz-masaren indizearen (GMI) 
arabera. GMIa honela definitzen da: pisua kilotan, garaieraren karratuarekin zatituta, 
metrotan.

Gizentzat hartzen dira 30 urteko edo gehiagoko GMI duten 18 urteko edo gehiagoko pertsonak.

eu.justificacion_global:
EBk neurri handi batean gosearen arazoak gainditu baditu ere, nutrizioarekin lotutako 
erronka berriak sortzen ari dira, obesitatea handitzea, esaterako.

Horregatik, Europako adierazleak helduaroko obesitatea neurtzen du, eta GJH 2ren (goseari 
eta malnutrizioari amaiera ematea) eta GJH 3ren (osasun ona eta ongizatea) aurrerabidearen 
jarraipena egiteko erabiltzen da. Azken horiek Europako Batzordearen lehentasunetan sartuta 
daude, "Europako Akordio Berdea", "Pertsonentzat funtzionatuko duen ekonomia" eta "Europako 
gure bizimoduaren sustapena" delakoen esparruan.

EBren elikadura-politikak nutrizio-ekimenak biltzen ditu eta EBko estatu kideekin lan egiten 
du nutrizioaren eta jarduera fisikoaren arloko osasun publikoko hainbat ekimenetan, bizimodu 
osasungarria eta orekatua sustatzeko.
eu.comparabilidad: Helduen obesitate-tasa Europako adierazlearekin aldera daiteke.
